name: BrowserNav Settings
purpose: Sets the browser-style navigation settings for the session in $$BrowserNav: each window keeps its own history (commonHistory false) and inactive windows are not hidden.
callers: none found (may be called by name or at startup)
open_question: No caller found; the global $$BrowserNav must be set for the Back/Forward script to work, so it is likely run from startup by name.

name: Browser Nav (forward or backward)
purpose: Back and Forward buttons that move through the layout history kept in $$BrowserNav. Takes "Backward" or "Forward", moves the entry between the backward and forward lists, switches to the target window if it is a different one and goes to the target layout number. Beeps when there is no target.
open_question: History entries are recorded elsewhere (not by this script). The target layout is addressed by layout number, which a rebuild must replace with routes. Called from many layouts and a custom menu (see callers).
